source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
a. Record the date and time of the inspection.
b. Detail the type of appliance and its identification number if available.
c. Note the location of the appliance and any associated equipment.

3. Document the checklist used for the safety check.
   a. Include a copy of the standard inspection checklist.
   b. Mark each item on the checklist clearly indicating pass (✓) or fail (X).
   c. If an item is not applicable (N/A), clearly indicate why.

4. Clearly note all failed safety checks.
   a. List each failed inspection item and describe the specific nature of the failure.
   b. Take dated photographs of the failed components or faults if possible.
   c. Attach any relevant sketches or diagrams to further illustrate the issue.

5. Record remedial actions taken or recommended.
   a. If repairs were attempted, describe what was done and by whom.
   b. Indicate whether the failure must be attended
